snippet.title: Haunted Bloodlines - Official Gamescom Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2725610/Haunted_Bloodlines

Embark on a creepy adventure through a decaying mansion steeped in the eerie echoes of your family’s dark past. The walls whisper, shadows stalk, and your mind plays tricks on you as Haunted Bloodlines chips away at your sanity. Every step you take could be your last as this terrifying story unfolds. 

Connect with us:
Discord: https://discord.gg/jJA2yPgYVB
X: https://x.com/hauntedbloodlin
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/hauntedbloodlines  
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hauntedbloodlines

Find out more at https://www.iphigames.com
